name: A11y Enhancer
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
A11y Enhancer empowers your WordPress site with powerful accessibility tools, ensuring inclusivity for all users. This free plugin offers a sleek, customizable widget with features like font size adjustment, high-contrast mode, text spacing, grayscale mode, link underlining, and screen reader enhancements. Move the widget to either side or close it for a clutter-free experience, all with intuitive icons for ease of use.

Upgrade to A11y Enhancer Pro for premium features like AI-generated alt text, comprehensive WCAG compliance reports, and advanced color contrast analysis to elevate your site’s accessibility to the next level.

Free Features

  • Font Size Toggle: Switch between normal and large text for better readability.
  • High-Contrast Mode: Enhance visibility with a high-contrast theme.
  • Text Spacing: Increase letter and word spacing for easier reading.
  • Grayscale Mode: Reduce visual strain with a grayscale display.
  • Underline Links: Improve link visibility with underlines.
  • Screen Reader Mode: Add aria-labels to images for screen reader compatibility.
  • Move Widget: Reposition the widget to the left or right side.
  • Close/Reopen Widget: Hide the widget and reopen it with a single click.
  • Persistent Settings: Save user preferences across sessions.
  • Basic Accessibility Report: Check recent posts for missing image alt text.

Pro Features

  • AI Alt Text Generation: Automatically create descriptive alt text for images.
  • WCAG Compliance Reports: Detailed audits for WCAG 2.1 compliance.
  • Color Contrast Analyzer: Ensure text and background colors meet accessibility standards.
  • Custom Widget Styling: Tailor the widget’s appearance to match your brand.
  • Learn more at pluginjoy.com.

Why Choose A11y Enhancer?

  • WCAG Compliance: Aligns with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1).
  • User-Friendly: Intuitive interface with icon-driven controls.
  • Mobile-Optimized: Fully responsive, works seamlessly on all devices.
  • Lightweight: Minimal impact on site performance.
  • Free & Pro Options: Start with free tools, upgrade for premium features at pluginjoy.com.

Make your website accessible to everyone with A11y Enhancer. Install now and unlock pro features at pluginjoy.com!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the a11y-enhancer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > A11y Enhancer to configure widget position and features.
  4. Use the [a11y_enhancer] shortcode to display the widget in specific content areas.
  5. For advanced features like AI alt text and WCAG reports, upgrade to Pro at pluginjoy.com.
sections.faq:
What accessibility features are included in the free version?

The free version includes font size toggle, high-contrast mode, text spacing, grayscale mode, link underlining, screen reader adjustments, widget repositioning, and close/reopen functionality, all with persistent settings.

How do I access premium features?

Upgrade to A11y Enhancer Pro at pluginjoy.com for AI alt text, WCAG compliance reports, color contrast analysis, and custom styling.

Is the widget mobile-friendly?

Yes, A11y Enhancer is fully responsive, with a compact design and touch-optimized controls for mobile devices.

Can I customize the widget’s position?

Yes, choose between bottom-left or bottom-right in the settings, or use the “Move to Other Side” button to reposition it dynamically.

Does it support screen readers?

Yes, the widget includes ARIA labels and a screen reader mode that adds aria-labels to images. Pro features enhance this further at pluginjoy.com.

How do I ensure WCAG compliance?

The free version helps with basic accessibility. For full WCAG 2.1 compliance, upgrade to Pro for detailed reports and AI tools at pluginjoy.com.

  • Improved: Mobile responsiveness and touch controls.

  • Fixed: WordPress.org compliance (sanitization, escaping, local assets).

  • Initial release with font size, high-contrast, and screen reader features.
